points.description: States the circumstance: more hidden layers are needed when deep or critical (hierarchical) learning of features is required, i.e. when the problem needs features to be learned rather than a single hidden layer.
points.partial_credit: Half (0.25) if the student says multiple hidden layers are needed for complex problems without referring to learning or extracting features.

points.description: States the purpose: the hidden layers extract and learn features properly and efficiently so the network can perform the further task well.
points.partial_credit: Half (0.25) if the student says the layers learn features but omits that this is done properly/efficiently or for the further task.

points.description: Gives multiclass classification as an example of a case where multiple hidden layers are desirable.
Gives the XOR function as an example of a case where multiple hidden layers are desirable.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) need the circumstance (more hidden layers when deep/critical feature learning is required), the purpose (layers extract and learn features properly and efficiently for the further task), and both examples: multiclass classification and the XOR function. Each point is all-or-nothing except P1 and P2, which earn a quarter mark for a partly correct statement. Any wrong or unrelated example given as a desirable case costs the example point, and a vague statement such as "for complex problems" earns no credit on its own.
